$comment: The 8.0 rule registry (RFC 0008 §3.2). Ids are never reused: a rule whose meaning changes gets a new id and the old one is marked superseded. pending names the PR that implements the rule; the switch (RFC 0008 S1) needs every pending to be null. properties and guards name tests as module-directory:TestClass#test name; verifyRuleCoverage checks that they exist. A build or startup rule is covered by those tests instead of scenarios.
